shots.image: A row of three blue airplane passenger seats torn loose from the plane, falling through the open sky in a violent thunderstorm, no cabin, no walls and no windows around it, only dark storm clouds in every direction, HERO strapped into the end seat with her seatbelt fastened, her hair and dress whipping in the wind, eyes shut, bolts of lightning across the clouds, rain streaking past.
shots.motion: The seat row spins slowly like a falling maple seed as it drops through the storm clouds, lightning flashes, rain streaks past, the camera falls with it.

shots.image: High aerial view looking straight down at the endless Amazon rainforest canopy far below, thousands of round green treetops, a winding brown river, wisps of cloud, and small in the middle of the frame a row of three blue airplane seats with one girl in a light-blue dress strapped in, falling toward the trees.
shots.motion: The tiny seat row spins as it falls away from the camera toward the vast green canopy, clouds drift past.

shots.image: HERO lying unconscious, still strapped into a row of three broken blue airplane seats tipped over on the muddy floor of a dense rainforest under giant trees, morning mist, shafts of light, ferns, rain drops on the leaves.
shots.motion: Slow push-in as she slowly opens her eyes and lifts her head, mist drifts, drops fall from the leaves.

shots.image: A 1970s four-engine propeller airliner, plain white with a thin blue stripe and no markings, flying alone through the empty sky high above the endless green Amazon rainforest, towering dark thunderclouds building ahead, late morning light.
shots.motion: The camera flies alongside the airliner as it heads toward the towering thunderclouds, propellers spinning.

shots.image: Inside a 1970s airliner cabin, HERO sitting by the window next to her mother, a woman in her forties with short dark-blonde hair, small wrapped Christmas presents on their laps, HERO looking out of the window at the rainforest far below, warm light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in as Juliane looks out of the window and smiles, her mother turns to her, the cabin gently bumps.

shots.image: Inside a dark 1970s airliner cabin during a violent storm, the overhead bins burst open and bags and wrapped Christmas presents fall into the aisle, HERO gripping her armrest in fear, her mother holding her hand, lightning flashing in the windows.
shots.motion: The cabin shakes violently, bags tumble from the bins, lightning flashes in the windows, handheld camera shake.

shots.image: High in the sky inside dark storm clouds, far above the ground, a bright bolt of lightning strikes the right wing of a plain white four-engine propeller airliner with no markings, a blinding flash and fire on the wing, heavy rain, the airliner alone in the storm.
shots.motion: Lightning strikes the wing in a blinding flash, fire bursts out along the wing, the airliner lurches downward, the camera shakes.

shots.image: High in the sky inside a dark thunderstorm, far above the ground, a plain white four-engine propeller airliner breaking apart in mid-air, the fuselage torn in two, a wing breaking off, empty seats, luggage and debris flying out, fire, dark clouds, lightning.
shots.motion: The airliner breaks apart in slow motion, debris spins away through the storm clouds, lightning flashes.

shots.image: Wide shot of the dark rainforest floor under enormous trees with huge buttress roots, a tipped-over row of three blue airplane seats among ferns and scattered pieces of airplane metal, HERO sitting dazed in one seat, mist and rays of light.
shots.motion: Slow crane down through the leaves toward her as she sits dazed in the seat, mist drifts through the light rays.

shots.image: Close-up of HEROFACE, dazed and in shock, one eye swollen, small scratches and mud on her face, wet hair, a torn light-blue dress strap, dense green jungle behind, rain drops.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on her face as she blinks and looks around in shock, rain drops fall.

shots.image: HERO in her torn muddy light-blue dress, one bare foot and one white sandal, holding her shoulder in pain, searching among broken airplane seats and debris in the dense jungle, calling out, misty green light.
shots.motion: The camera tracks beside her as she stumbles through the debris looking left and right, calling out for her mother.

shots.image: Medium close-up of HERO sitting under a giant leaf in the rain, her face and arms muddy and scratched, looking down at a small crumpled paper bag of colorful wrapped candies that she holds open in both hands in front of her chest, dense jungle behind.
shots.motion: She takes one candy out of the little bag and looks at it, rain drops fall from the leaf, shallow depth of field.

shots.image: HERO kneeling beside a small clear stream in the dense rainforest, touching the water with her hand, huge leaves and hanging vines around her, a beam of sunlight.
shots.motion: Slow push-in as she touches the water and looks downstream, the stream flows and sparkles.

shots.image: HERO wading knee-deep down a shallow jungle stream toward the camera in her torn muddy light-blue dress, arms out for balance, giant trees and hanging vines on both banks, green light.
shots.motion: The camera moves backward ahead of her as she wades down the stream toward the camera, water splashing around her legs.

shots.image: Aerial drone view from high above a wide winding brown river through endless dense green Amazon rainforest, mist over the trees, and far below near the bank HERO wading waist-deep down the river, seen very small from above.
shots.motion: Smooth drone flight forward along the river, slowly descending toward the small wading girl.

shots.image: HERO floating on her back down a wide calm brown jungle river at dusk, the sky orange and purple, dark trees on the banks, mist on the water.
shots.motion: The camera drifts beside her as the current carries her slowly downstream, mist moves over the water.

shots.image: Close-up of HERO sitting on a muddy riverbank, exhausted and thin, looking with fear at a dirty cloth bandage tied around her upper arm, small flies around it, jungle behind.
shots.motion: Slow push-in as she lifts her arm and looks at the bandage with fear, the flies buzz around.

shots.image: A small wooden boat with an outboard motor tied to the muddy bank of a wide jungle river, a path leading up to a simple palm-thatched wooden hut, HERO stumbling along the bank toward it, afternoon light.
shots.motion: The camera follows her as she stumbles along the bank toward the boat and the hut.

shots.image: HERO sitting on the plank floor of a simple wooden jungle hut next to a rusty metal fuel barrel, tipping a small tin can so that a thin stream of fuel pours directly onto the dirty bandage on her own upper arm, the liquid running down her arm, grimacing in pain, light through gaps in the walls.
shots.motion: Slow push-in as she pours the fuel onto her arm and squeezes her eyes shut in pain.

shots.image: Three Peruvian lumberjacks in work clothes and rubber boots standing in the doorway of a wooden jungle hut, staring in shock at HERO who sits weak and exhausted on the floor, golden evening light.
shots.motion: The men step back in shock, then one slowly kneels down toward her, the camera pushes in.

shots.image: Wide shot of HERO standing alone on a sandy riverbank, tiny against an enormous wall of dense rainforest and a wide brown river, golden light, birds flying.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pulls back and rises, making her smaller and smaller against the endless jungle.

shots.image: Sunrise over the Amazon rainforest, a small wooden research station with a tall wooden lookout tower in a clearing beside a river, mist over the treetops, a woman with grey hair standing on a wooden walkway looking out over the jungle.
shots.motion: Slow drone flight toward the research station over the misty treetops at sunrise.
